subject: Order hasn't arrived — been 3 weeks!
body: I placed order #[ID] on the 1st of May. It is now the 22nd and nothing has arrived. I have a birthday event this weekend and I desperately need the item.
notes: Explicit time pressure (event this weekend) + long delay = high

subject: URGENT — delivery critical for tomorrow
body: I need my order delivered by tomorrow morning for a medical appointment. Please escalate immediately.
notes: Medical context + explicit urgency marker + hard deadline

subject: Order missing for 2 weeks, leaving for holiday Friday
body: My order was placed 14 days ago and still hasn't arrived. I'm leaving the country on Friday and won't be home to receive it.
notes: Hard external deadline + long delay

subject: Still waiting after promised delivery date passed
body: You told me it would arrive by the 10th. It is now the 15th. I need this resolved today.
notes: Broken promise + explicit 'today' demand

subject: Wrong item sent — event tonight
body: I ordered a suit for a wedding tonight and received completely the wrong item. This is a disaster.
notes: Wrong item + extreme time pressure

subject: Package never arrived, gift for child's birthday tomorrow
body: My son's birthday is tomorrow and the gift I ordered three weeks ago has not arrived. This is completely unacceptable.
notes: Hard deadline (tomorrow) + emotional context + long delay

subject: Order delayed — flight in 48 hours
body: I ordered travel adapters and luggage locks for a flight on Thursday morning. Nothing has arrived. I fly in 48 hours.
notes: Hard travel deadline + critical items + explicit time window

subject: Received someone else's order — need mine today
body: The package I received has someone else's name and address on it. I needed my own order for a presentation this afternoon.
notes: Fulfilment error + same-day deadline

subject: Account charged but no order confirmation — urgent
body: £85 was taken from my account 20 minutes ago but I received no order confirmation and cannot see the order in my account.
notes: Financial issue + immediate, unresolved transaction

subject: Item broken on arrival — needed for event this evening
body: The item arrived broken. I need a working replacement sent out today — I have a client dinner this evening and this was a gift.
notes: Defective + hard same-day deadline

subject: Wrong item received, no rush
body: I ordered a blue mug but received a red one. Not urgent but I would like to exchange it at some point.
notes: Wrong item but customer explicitly says not urgent

subject: Package arrived damaged
body: My parcel arrived this morning with a cracked lid. The product inside seems okay but the packaging is broken.
notes: Defect but no time pressure, product functional

subject: Order delayed — no update from courier
body: My order was supposed to arrive 3 days ago. The tracking hasn't updated since Tuesday. Can you chase this up?
notes: Delay without explicit urgency signals

subject: Part of my order is missing
body: I ordered 3 items but only 2 arrived. The missing item is order line #[ID]. Please advise.
notes: Partial fulfilment, no time pressure stated

subject: Charged twice for one order
body: I can see two charges on my bank statement for order #[ID]. Can you refund the duplicate?
notes: Financial error, requires action but not time-critical

subject: Item quality does not match website photos
body: The product I received looks significantly different to the photos on the website. The colour is much darker and the finish is rough. I want to return it.
notes: Quality mismatch, customer wants action but no deadline stated

subject: Discount code not applied at checkout
body: I used the code SAVE10 at checkout but my order confirmation shows the full price. I want the discount refunded.
notes: Billing discrepancy requiring resolution, no urgency signals

subject: Order stuck in customs for a week
body: My international order has been held in customs for 7 days. The tracking shows no movement. Can you help expedite this?
notes: Delay with ambiguous urgency — no explicit deadline but significant wait time

subject: Subscription auto-renewed without warning
body: My annual subscription renewed and I was charged £49 without a reminder email. I did not intend to renew. Please refund.
notes: Unexpected charge, requires action, no extreme time pressure

subject: Delivery driver left parcel with wrong neighbour
body: The tracking says delivered but I did not receive my parcel. A neighbour says the driver may have knocked at the wrong door.
notes: Lost delivery, no hard deadline but needs investigation

subject: General question about returns policy
body: How many days do I have to return an item if I change my mind? And do I need the original packaging?
notes: Policy question, no purchase or problem mentioned

subject: How do I track my order?
body: I placed an order yesterday. How can I see where it is?
notes: Information request, order presumably on schedule

subject: Can I change my delivery address?
body: I placed an order this morning. Is it too late to change the delivery address to my work address?
notes: Change request, order recent, no urgency signals

subject: Feedback on my recent order
body: I just wanted to say that my recent order arrived quickly and the packaging was lovely. Really happy with the service.
notes: Compliment, no action required

subject: Question about product availability
body: I noticed the blue version of the mug is out of stock. Do you know when it will be back?
notes: Stock enquiry, no purchase yet, no urgency

subject: Is gift wrapping available?
body: I am planning to order a birthday gift next week. Do you offer gift wrapping or a gift note option at checkout?
notes: Pre-purchase enquiry, no order placed, no time pressure

subject: Can I add an item to an existing order?
body: I just placed an order and forgot to add another item. Is it possible to add to it before it ships?
notes: Order modification request, no urgency language, order just placed

subject: Request for invoice copy
body: Could you send me a copy of my invoice for order #[ID]? I need it for my expense claim.
notes: Administrative request, no time pressure stated

subject: Query about size guide
body: I am considering purchasing a coat but I am unsure whether to order a medium or large. Do you have a detailed size guide?
notes: Pre-purchase sizing question, no urgency

subject: How long does standard delivery take?
body: I am not in a rush but would like to know the typical delivery window for standard shipping before I place an order.
notes: Pre-purchase information request, customer explicitly says no rush
